title: dodag.py: select_parent() is public but requires external lock
description:
**File:** python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py line 702

**Severity:** P2 (thread safety contract)

**Summary:** select_parent() is a public method (no underscore prefix) that modifies critical state (preferred_parent, rank, role, _lowest_rank, gateway_centric, grounded) without acquiring self._lock. It is designed to be called only from locked contexts (_process_dio_unlocked, remove_parent), but nothing prevents external callers from invoking it directly without holding the lock.

**Failure scenario:** An external caller (e.g., a higher-level component or test) calls select_parent() without holding self._lock while another thread is in process_dio(). Concurrent modification of self.parents, self.rank, etc. causes data races. While Python GIL prevents memory corruption, it does not prevent inconsistent state (e.g., rank updated but preferred_parent still points to old parent).

**Recommendation:** Either rename to _select_parent() to signal it is internal, or have it acquire self._lock internally (requires changing callers to not double-lock, since _lock is an RLock this would be safe).
